allow: PowerShell($env:CHROME_PATH="C:\\Program Files\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\chrome.exe"; npx --yes lighthouse@12 http://localhost:4322/ --quiet --output=json --output-path="$env:TEMP\\lh.json" --chrome-flags="--headless=new --no-sandbox" --preset=desktop 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 8; "=== exit: $LASTEXITCODE ===")

PowerShell($r = Get-Content "$env:TEMP\\lh.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $ids = $r.categories.accessibility.auditRefs | ForEach-Object { $_.id }; foreach \($id in $ids\) { $a = $r.audits.$id; if \($a.score -ne $null -and $a.score -lt 1\) { "[$\($a.score\)] $id  ::  $\($a.title\)"; foreach \($item in $a.details.items\) { "      -> " + $item.node.snippet } } })
